messages.text: Batch 214 of the niacinamide serum came back from stability at 40C/75%RH with a slight yellow tint at week 8. Formula identical to batch 209 which was fine. Only difference: new supplier for the glycerin. Took us 3 weeks to trace it. Everyone assumes the active is the problem. It's almost never the active.

Customer DM today: 'why is your sunscreen SPF 30 and not 50, is it weaker?' Third time this month. People think SPF is linear. SPF 30 blocks ~97% UVB, SPF 50 ~98%. The real variable is how much you apply - almost nobody applies 2mg/cm2.
amma's birthday next week, book the hall
Thinking about how 'fragrance-free' on a label means nothing without knowing whether masking agents were used. Want to write about this at some point.
We switched our moisturiser from a jar to an airless pump. Returns for 'texture changed' dropped a lot over the next quarter. Oxygen exposure every time you open a jar. People blame the formula.

text: percentages on labels are mostly meaningless because brands list the ceramide complex %, not actual ceramide content. A 5% ceramide complex can be under 0.1% actual ceramides. Nobody asks for the breakdown.
